question: The Indian National Congress was established when 72 delegates from all over the country met at Bombay in December ______.
solution:
The correct answer is 1855.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Indian National Congress:-**

 
 
• It was founded in 1885, and in pre-independence India, it grew to become one of the most powerful and prominent political parties.
 
• **The First Session of the Indian National Congress (INC) was held in Bombay on 28 December 1885 and continued until 31 December. (Hence option 4 is correct)**
 
• The First session of INC was attended by 72 members.
 
• It was initiated by Allan Octavian Hume, a former British civil servant, with Dadabhai Naoroji and Dinshaw Wacha.
 
• The first INC president was Womesh Chandra Bonnerjee. 
 
• Lord Dufferin was the Viceroy of India during the foundation of INC.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__ **

 
• Badruddin Tyabji was the first Muslim President of the INC.
 
• Annie Besant was the first woman president of INC. 
 
• Sarojini Naidu was the first Indian woman to become the president of INC.
 
• George Yule was the first English president of INC.
